title: Crisp Slovakian Salad with Danmuji
description: A refreshing Thai-inspired salad featuring crisp Slovakian ingredients and the sweetness of danmuji.
instructions: 1. Slice the Slovakian radishes and mixed greens into thin strips.
2. Cut the danmuji into bite-sized pieces.
3. Heat the peanuts in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
4. In a large bowl, combine the sliced radishes, mixed greens, danmuji, and peanuts.
5. In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar to make the dressing.
6. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
7. Slice the chili peppers and add them to the salad.
9. Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves, if desired.
